message: form field needs an id of a-z, 0-9 and '-'
hint: Give it an id such as "export-format": the answers are kept by it.

message: form field kind must be "text", "radio", "checkbox" or "rating"
hint: A form field is {"$input": "radio", "id": "export", "label": "Export?", "options": ["Yes", {"label": "No", "description": "Why not", "recommended": true}]}; $input is text, radio, checkbox or rating.

message: form field radio needs at least 2 options
form field options must have distinct non-empty labels

message: form field id "same" is used twice in the document
hint: Give every form field of the document its own id.
